changes.title: Notices
changes.oldText: All notices shall be sent to CloudDesk at Level 4, 12 MG Road, Bengaluru 560001.
changes.newText: All notices shall be sent to CloudDesk at Tower B, 7th Floor, Outer Ring Road, Bengaluru 560103.

changes.title: Definitions
changes.oldText: "effective date" means the date on which this Agreement is signed by both parties.
changes.newText: "Effective Date" means the date on which this Agreement is signed by both parties.

changes.title: Limitation of liability
changes.oldText: Each party's total liability shall not exceed the fees paid in the twelve (12) months before the claim.
changes.newText: Each party's total liability shall not exceed the fees paid in the six (6) months before the claim.

changes.title: Renewal
changes.oldText: This Agreement renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party gives thirty (30) days' written notice.
changes.newText: This Agreement renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party gives ninety (90) days' written notice.

changes.title: Service credits
changes.oldText: Service credits are applied automatically to the next invoice.
changes.newText: Service credits are payable only if Customer submits a written claim within ten (10) days of the end of the month in which the failure occurred.

changes.title: Fees
changes.oldText: The Fees are fixed for the Initial Term and any Renewal Term.
changes.newText: Supplier may revise the Fees once in each contract year by written notice.
